items.en_title: Boston Roxbury first-come closes Jan 31, 2027: 3 homes
items.en_oneliner: A first-come opening in Boston's Roxbury closes Jan 31, 2027 with 3 homes; the neighborhood is changing fast and below-market homes are one of the few ways to stay in it, so use the comfortable window rather than waiting until late January.
